descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S27 「保留窗口：超过窗口的存储数据不被引用（3.6/3.7），以及只有昨天的化验（Q6）」 Retention windows: stored data past its window is not quoted (3.6/3.7), and yesterday-only labs (Q6)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Ask AI never quotes stored data past its retention window: Hospital pre-round text 12 h, encounter dictation 18 h (then yesterday's transcript to 36 h), labs/vitals 36 h after last refresh, prior tra …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given (a) Hospital: pre-round note aged 13 h, labs last refreshed 37 h ago, and a control patient at 11 h / 35 h. (b) NH resident with three prior visits, each with one distinct fact. (c) Hospital labs only from yesterday, within 36 h

When (a) ask the pre-round and today's-labs presets; (b) ask "What did the resident report at the earlier visits?"; (c) ask "What were today's labs?"

Then (a) the aged patient's answers say none (the control quotes them); (b) only the last two visits' facts are cited; (c) per Q6

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：(a)/(b) from 3.6: anything past its window in the answer is a Fail, quoted. (c) not judged until Q6 is answered and labs carry a date

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
